title: An item whose workers keep dying at startup stops and says why in one plain line
description: GY-3510: three consecutive claims on one item that each expire within 5 minutes of claiming stop its dispatch with one blocker naming the last worker's exit reason; a submitted or longer claim resets the count and other items are unaffected. Against a real control plane and isolated Postgres, the item's page then shows 'Workers keep failing to start: <reason>' with one who-acts-next line and no sideways scroll at 1280 and 390 wide.

steps.name: three short expired claims block the item with the last exit reason; resets and neighbours hold
the item page shows one plain line and one next action at 1280 and 390
